name: Process, Workflow, Method and Procedure completion
constraints: Reuse both reserved runtime identifiers and preserve legacy assemblies byte-identically as non-installable references.
Method and procedure knowledge, edition-scoped instruction content, immutable editions, competence requirements and adoption records remain owned by vr.wm-act-009.
Process family, mandatory variants, immutable released definitions, instances and append-only trace events remain owned by vr.wm-act-003.
Task, assignment, atomic act, policy, actor and evidence identities remain external references.
Definition, instance and execution knowledge pins are zero-to-many and digest checked end to end.
All execution-state changes are immutable events on one cross-type monotonic sequence; current state is derived.
In-flight rebinding requires an authorized CutoverRecord and never repoints earlier records.
Conformance fixes ordered pin regimes, trace digest and rule-set version; incomplete coverage is inconclusive.
Legacy unsupported conformance and wildcard-import claims are retracted externally without editing frozen bytes.
Publication is refused while fixturesExecuted is false, publishableCanonical is false or any release hold is open.
